data.name: House and Hand
data.detailed_description:
House and Hand is a match-3 puzzle roguelike.

Place forests, mountains, cities, and more on islands. Match three to evolve bigger and better features. Gain new powers and discover game-changing policies to create high-scoring synergies. Earn enough points and sail to the next island!

Key Features:

Unique Match-3 Roguelike - Match 3 or more to earn points in this unique match-3 roguelike where every run offers fresh challenges with unique ways to strategically build your deck.

Impactful Effect Cards - Earn impactful effect cards that can earn you more points, eliminate obstacles or hoard more gold.

Powerful Policies - Discover game-changing policies that change the rules and transform how you play. Stack synergies and build powerful scoring combinations!

City Building Meets Puzzles - Watch humble settlements grow into bustling metropolises as you cleverly arrange and match your features.

Pick Up and Play - Perfect for quick sessions or longer puzzle marathons. Each run delivers satisfying progression without demanding huge time commitments

Charming Pixel Art - Vibrant, colorful islands come alive with cute buildings and a delightful pixel art aesthetic

Master the perfect balance of strategy and luck in this match-3 puzzle game. With countless Policy combinations, cards to purchase, and endless replayability, no two runs are ever the same.

data.short_description: Building thriving island cities in this addictive match-3 deck-building roguelike! Place forests, mountains, cities, and more on islands using cards from your deck. Match 3 identical features to combine them into a bigger, better features that scores you points.
